description: This Java class 'HttpPushValidator' provides validation logic for HTTP Push connection configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It ensures the correctness of connection scheme, target address format, supported HTTP methods, and parallelism settings.

classes.name: HttpPushValidator
classes.description: Validator for HTTP Push connections, ensuring proper scheme, method, address format, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HttpPushValidator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type this validator supports, which is HTTP_PUSH.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a given Connection object, including URI scheme, source and target configs, payload mappings, and parallelism.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Ensures that the source configuration is empty as per connection type constraints.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target address and header mappings, ensuring correct format and supported HTTP methods.

methods.name: validateTargetAddress
methods.description: Checks the format of the target address, especially for method and path separation.

methods.name: validateHttpMethod
methods.description: Validates that the HTTP method specified in the target address is supported.

methods.name: validateParallelism
methods.description: Validates the parallelism setting, ensuring it is a positive integer.

methods.name: parallelismValidationFailed
methods.description: Constructs an exception for invalid parallelism configuration.

methods.name: isSecureScheme
methods.description: Checks if the URL scheme is HTTPS, indicating a secure connection.
